Basic Investment Information

We know that people are going to come at investment from different levels of understanding and education, and we are here to help everybody, no matter where they are on their path to knowledge. One thing we want to do that is different from many other solutions out there, is to provide help to people who have absolutely no understanding of the world of investments at all. We are going to dramatically simplify things here, but we feel it is important to take an opportunity to lay out a few terms and definitions that will be helpful for those with only an interest or curiosity under their belt. If you already have a basic understanding of what investments are and the different types that are out there, you can feel free to skip this section.

What is an investment?

This might seem like a silly question, but it actually isn't at all. At its simplest, an investment is something that you put some amount of money into, with the idea that it will appreciate in value in some period of time. You provide money to a company or a product and then obtain some type of gain or income as a result.

Now, it is important to point out that this is the goal of investing. However, not all investments turn out as you want. Some of them will go bust and you will lose what you put in. Not everything is a guarantee and this is part of the risk of investing. As you gain in your knowledge, you will learn more about how to choose a good investment that gives you the best possible chance of getting a good return on what you put in.

What Types of Investments Are There?

There are a ton of kinds of investment, but here, we will briefly take a look at the most common: stocks, real estate, and cryptocurrency.

Stock is one of the most popular and well-known types of investments. A stock can be thought of as bits of ownership in a company. Say you have a big company that you want to open to investment - you would then take the company "public" by breaking it down into a certain number of stocks at a particular valuation. Investors can then buy these shares in the business and as the business waxes or wanes, so too do the values of these stocks.

Many people will not simply have all their money in a single stock, but rather a whole host of different stocks as a way to spread risk through diversification, but you will learn more about that at a later time.

Real estate is something that is pretty easy to understand from a small-scale level. It is the ownership of homes or land that you can then sell or rent out at a profit. However, there are also investment firms that have portfolios that allow you to invest in something akin to a share of a neighborhood or large group of homes. A lot of people prefer this kind of investment at first because it tends to have a lower risk than other forms of investment.

The idea is that, since property and space are finite, the value of that asset will grow over time as the market continues to shrink. It does have its own unique risks, of course.

Cryptocurrencies are a relatively new form of investment. While it has been around for well over a decade, it is only recently starting to gain ground in the wider world of investment. This is a pretty complicated form of investment in terms of explaining what it is. The easiest way to understand crypto is to think of it like the traditional money market, but rather than being backed by a central authority, it is decentralized. A lot of people feel like this is the future of monetary policy and that it isn't reliant on any central authority.

It is important to note that as it isn't reliant on any central authority, there is no overarching monetary policy which means that the swings between highs and lows in this market can be quite dramatic and can happen quickly which make it inherently risky as an investment.

What Are Your Investment Options?

There are a lot of different ways that you can go about investing. What works best for you will depend on your confidence in your knowledge and skill, as well as the amount of time you have to dedicate to it. The most obvious way to invest is through general trading. This is something that the average person can do from the comfort of their home. You can easily buy and sell a huge number of different assets from stocks to cryptocurrency.

Some people will choose to have a stockbroker. This is someone who is an expert in the field of stocks that will manage your money in a portfolio of stocks that they have chosen. When you work with a stockbroker, you tend to stick with traditional stocks. This isn't where you get involved in real estate investment.

There are also hedge funds. A lot of people like hedge funds as they seek to diversify, or spread, risk. Rather than investing in one commodity or market, hedge funds invest in a whole wealth of different kinds of financial instruments. These are some of the safer means of investment, but it should also be said that while you can get good gains from here since the risk is more mitigated, the gains will be more modest than with riskier forms of investing.

You can even go for more informal means of investing as well. Say you have a friend with a great idea for a product or service. Well, investing with their company is another means by which you can get involved in the investment market.
